preview_observation.scope: Hainan 42-second 1080p/25fps project, native preview540 cached playback: first play after manifest preparation, replay, title edit and replay, seek to 24s and backward to 12s. Draw submissions and device receipts; physical output is separate.

preview_observation.does_not_establish: Arbitrary projects, uncached zero-stall playback, strict pixel equivalence, physical sound/output or cross-platform qualification.
preview_observation.candidate_scope: Prior preview candidate and original Hainan revision; not rerun for the UI/media fix or the user-added effect layer.
